description.zh: 模拟 orchestrator.rs 对工具调用的完整三阶段处理：Phase 1 Approval（ExecApprovalRequirement）→ Phase 2 First Attempt（沙箱执行）→ Phase 3 Escalation（SandboxDenied 升级重试）。包含 Forbidden 直接拒绝和沙箱拒绝后的升级流程。
description.en: Simulate orchestrator.rs full three-phase tool call handling: Phase 1 Approval → Phase 2 First Attempt (sandboxed) → Phase 3 Escalation (SandboxDenied retry). Covers Forbidden direct reject and sandbox escalation.

steps.content: 帮我检查 Rust 项目能否编译

annotation.zh: 工具调用进入 ToolOrchestrator::run()，approval_policy = AskForApproval::OnFailure
annotation.en: Tool call enters ToolOrchestrator::run(), approval_policy = AskForApproval::OnFailure

annotation.zh: orchestrator.rs:Phase 1 — default_exec_approval_requirement() 返回 Skip，自动批准，记录 OTEL 遥测
annotation.en: orchestrator.rs:Phase 1 — default_exec_approval_requirement() returns Skip, auto-approved, OTEL telemetry recorded

annotation.zh: orchestrator.rs:Phase 2 — SandboxManager 选择 LinuxSeccomp，run_attempt() 执行，返回 Ok
annotation.en: orchestrator.rs:Phase 2 — SandboxManager selects LinuxSeccomp, run_attempt() executes, returns Ok

annotation.zh: ExecApprovalRequirement::Skip → Phase 3 不触发。OrchestratorRunResult { output, deferred_network_approval: None }
annotation.en: ExecApprovalRequirement::Skip → Phase 3 not triggered. OrchestratorRunResult { output, deferred_network_approval: None }

steps.content:
Compiling myapp v0.1.0
    Finished dev [unoptimized] target(s) in 2.1s

annotation.zh: Phase 1→2 完成，无需升级。结果通过 FuturesOrdered 写回 session history
annotation.en: Phase 1→2 complete, no escalation needed. Result written to session history via FuturesOrdered

annotation.zh: 模型生成 rm -rf /tmp/build-cache，该命令会触发危险命令检测
annotation.en: Model generates rm -rf /tmp/build-cache, which triggers dangerous command detection

annotation.zh: orchestrator.rs — rm -rf 触发 NeedsApproval，start_approval_async() 向 TUI 发送 ExecApprovalRequest，阻塞等待用户
annotation.en: orchestrator.rs — rm -rf triggers NeedsApproval, start_approval_async() sends ExecApprovalRequest to TUI, blocking

annotation.zh: 用户选择 ApprovedForSession：本次 session 内相同命令前缀不再询问，OTEL 记录 User 来源的决策
annotation.en: User selects ApprovedForSession: same command prefix auto-approved for rest of session, OTEL logs User-sourced decision

annotation.zh: Phase 1 Approved → Phase 2: LinuxSeccomp 沙箱执行。/tmp 路径在 WorkspaceWrite 策略外，若沙箱拒绝则进入 Phase 3
annotation.en: Phase 1 Approved → Phase 2: LinuxSeccomp sandbox executes. /tmp outside WorkspaceWrite policy, sandbox may deny

annotation.zh: orchestrator.rs — 沙箱拒绝进入 Phase 3：escalate_on_failure=true，提示用户是否以 SandboxType::None 重试
annotation.en: orchestrator.rs — sandbox denial enters Phase 3: escalate_on_failure=true, asks user whether to retry without sandbox

annotation.zh: orchestrator.rs — Phase 3 以 SandboxType::None 重试，移除沙箱限制后命令成功执行
annotation.en: orchestrator.rs — Phase 3 retries with SandboxType::None, command succeeds without sandbox restriction

annotation.zh: Phase 3 重试成功。OrchestratorRunResult 返回，结果写入 session history
annotation.en: Phase 3 retry succeeded. OrchestratorRunResult returned, result written to session history
